heroTitle: Shaping the future of steel reuse
heroLede: Circular Steel is the leading industry platform dedicated to advancing the reuse of structural steel.
introText: We bring together engineers, developers, contractors, fabricators, policymakers and innovators to turn circular economy ambition into practical delivery. Through focused events, collaboration and knowledge-sharing, Circular Steel helps the built environment move from isolated reuse projects to scalable industry practice.
whyMattersBody1: Steel reuse is one of the most powerful levers available to reduce embodied carbon in construction. Yet delivering it at scale requires coordination across the entire value chain — Circular Steel exists to connect that ecosystem.
whyMattersBody2: Circular Steel events are practical, collaborative and industry-led — focused on real projects, real challenges and real delivery.
twoSeriesUkText: Circular Steel UK — our flagship annual London event brings together the most advanced steel reuse projects and practitioners in the industry.
twoSeriesUsaText: Circular Steel USA — building on UK leadership, Circular Steel USA supports the growth of reuse practice across North America.
